newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea First to seek court protection for Hanbo Engineering.
newsitem.headline: Korea First to seek court protection for Hanbo Engineering.

text.p: Korea First Bank, the main creditor to Hanbo Engineering and Construction Co, plans to seek court receivership for the troubled construction firm, an official at the bank said on Friday.
He said Hanbo Engineering, an unlisted affiliate of the troubled Hanbo Group, had failed to honour 6.5 billion won worth of promissory notes by the final deadline on Friday.
"After failing to honour the notes on maturity yesterday, the company missed the final deadline today," said the official. "Our bank plans to seek court protection and then a buyer for the company."
The Hanbo Group has been in trouble since its flagship, Hanbo Steel Co, was declared insolvent in late January under $5.8 billion in debts.
Hanbo Steel, South Korea's second-largest steel maker, has been seeking court receivership.

The steelmaker's collapse uncovered a poor system of credit analysis and corrupt lending practices, and sparked a bribes-for-loans scandal that has put three top bankers and several of President Kim Young-sam's closest aides on trial.
It also shook the stock and money markets on fears of a domino effect of corporate failures.
